$comment: Quality critic thresholds. A sound fails a check when its measurement crosses the limit. Defaults are set between what good library patches measure and what deliberately broken test sounds measure; families that are aggressive by design get wider limits. Every sound the human flags should tighten or add a rule here. The terror family (LORN-style) must also sound alive: a 7 s held note is measured for slow and fast movement and for how periodic that movement is.

noteSpreadDb.label: level jumps between low and high notes

lifeSlowDb.label: slow movement over a held note (alive, not seasick)

lifeFastDb.label: fast movement within a held note
